A Note on Curvature-Dimension Conditions and $L^1$ Optimal Transport

June 2026

optimal transport
Drive

These notes study the curvature-dimension condition $\text{CD}(K,N)$ and its connection to $L^1$ optimal transport. After reviewing Kantorovich duality and Brenier’s theorem, I derive $\text{CD}(K,N)$ for Riemannian manifolds via Ricci curvature — covering the Jacobian of the exponential map, Bochner’s formula, and the $\Gamma_2$ calculus — as motivation for the metric measure space formulation. Examples include the one-dimensional and spherical cases. I also note that $\text{CD}(K,N)$ bounds for von Mises–Fisher distributions appear to be absent from the literature. The notes close with measure disintegration and transport sets in the $L^1$ setting. This document is a huge effort but is not perfect either. Any correction is welcome.

Solutions to Brownian Motion, Martingales, and Stochastic Calculus (sample version)

July 2026

stochastic calculus
Drive

There are two purposes of this document: to help readers who have already spent time thinking about the exercises but have been stuck for a while, and to provide solutions that are more natural, straightforward, and readable than the existing ones. The PDF is NOT DOWNLOADABLE. I hope this small inconvenience can encourage readers to think more actively rather than relying on the solutions too quickly. Due to personal reasons, I did not work on the exercises in Chapter 9, but all the remaining exercises are included.
